positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Orro is an adaptive lighting and smart home system that supports better living by making it easier to manage your home. As an embedded engineer, I work closely with the HW and SW teams developing new products and features for the Orro One and Orro S smart light switches.

- Program Manager for Orro S new product launch, overseeing all efforts from EVT through launch, reporting to CEO 
- Coordinated internal engineering and business team deliverables and managed build schedules with CM
- Created custom Java/Kotlin application for core architecture implementation on custom hardware
- Defined and implemented core lighting controls, Orro REST and PubSub API, and OTA update processes
- Led new SW/FW feature development, working with design, product, engineering, QA and support
- Using Yocto, built custom Linux OS, various drivers, U-boot customizations, SensorHAL layers, JNI libraries
- Developed firmware for PIC16, Cortex M0/M4/M7, and Cypress PSoC processors for features incl.: multi-phase dimming, voltage, current, power sensing and calculation, and novel multiway toggle support
- Maintained and supported Android and Yocto build system CI/CD, utilizing Jenkins, Docker, and GitHub Actions
- Designed custom APIs and data pipelines utilizing AWS API Gateway, Lambda, S3, Kinesis, Elastic Search
- Ported audio recognition library tensorflowlite to ARM core with custom JNI wrapper for use in JVM app
- Designed, implemented, and supported system level manufacturing tests and processes to facilitate production
- Represented Orro at trade shows and industry events, networking with potential customers and partners

Orro Tech Stack:
https://stackshare.io/orro

Reviews:
https://www.residentialsystems.com/technology/lighting-shades/review-orro-one-smart-touchscreen-lighting-controller
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · Kotlin · Program Management · C++

positions.title: Member, Engineering Leadership Development Program
positions.description:
As a member of the RELDP program, I rotated between 3 different engineering positions across the company over 2 years. 

3rd Rotation: Digital Force Technologies in San Diego, CA. Electrical and Firmware Engineer. Responsibilities included development of FW for Atmel xMega microcontrollers for a wide variety of products, implementing communications protocols between our systems and Sony, Canon, and Hitachi cameras. Additionally, schematic design and PCB layout (using Altium Designer) for digital video (HDMI and 4k) processing, networking, and power management designs.

2nd Rotation: Missile Systems in Tucson, AZ. Software Engineer in the Advanced Missile Systems Software Department. Developed various software services for a real time embedded system on Linux platform, utilizing RTI's DDS middleware. Led integration efforts with various vendors/sub-contractors, and coordinated day-to-day execution of software team.

1st Rotation: Space and Airborne Systems in El Segundo, CA. Electrical Engineer working in the Digital Receiver Department. Developed and verified PWB layout guidelines through signal and power integrity analysis (using Mentor Graphics HyperLynx) on a wide range of designs. Additionally, was the REA for module test, overseeing test procedures, training, and troubleshooting of production hardware.

positions.title: Graduate Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Graduate student at UW-Madison and a researcher for the Wisconsin Electric Machines and Power Electronics Consortium (WEMPEC).  Investigated the use of wide bandgap semiconductor devices in power electronic systems for various applications, including electric vehicles, PV, wind energy converters, and high speed motor drives. My thesis involved the development of a novel three phase inverter topology with reduced common mode voltage and EMI emissions.

positions.title: Electronics Center Intern
positions.description: Assisted in various test data collection methods and created post-processing solutions to streamline dissemination of crucial results.

positions.title: Product Engineering Intern
positions.description: As a part of the Microelectronics division, my responsibilities included supporting the PE Diagnostic team.  My work was closely related to application development and data analytics.

positions.title: Intern, Business Support
positions.description: As a member of the EDI Support Team, I designed and developed a web application to aid in the Invoice Resend process.
